title: HtmlMeter
responsibility: Renders the native meter element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlMeter.attributes
inputs.description: Native meter attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlMeter.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native meter element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlMeter
outputs.description: The actual native meter element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
